boards.title: Your First Weekend at Southwestern University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe campus sequence built around named stops on Southwestern’s official self-guided walking tour.

cards.title: Start at the Welcome Center
cards.subtitle: Arrival point for the official campus walking tour
cards.notes: Meet up here, orient yourself to campus, and use the nearby tour materials before choosing your first route across campus.
cards.short_summary: Begin with the university’s visitor-facing starting point.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern’s self-guided walking tour starts in the plaza between the Welcome Center and the Cullen Building.
cards.access_notes: Use the official tour page and campus map for wayfinding; confirm any building-entry conditions locally.

cards.title: Get your campus bearings at Cullen
cards.subtitle: Early stop on Southwestern’s self-guided walking tour
cards.notes: Pause outside the Cullen Building, compare your route with the tour sequence, and take a few minutes to learn the layout.
cards.short_summary: Use a historic academic building as a first orientation landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: The Roy & Lillie Cullen Building is a named stop on Southwestern’s self-guided walking tour.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor viewing is the simplest option; follow posted access guidance for interior spaces.

cards.title: Continue to Mood-Bridwell
cards.subtitle: Named academic stop on the campus tour
cards.notes: Walk to Mood-Bridwell as a short next leg, then use the official tour video to connect the building to its campus context.
cards.short_summary: Keep the first walk compact with a named academic-tour stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Mood-Bridwell Building is included on Southwestern’s self-guided walking tour.
cards.access_notes: Follow campus signage and posted building-access rules.

cards.title: Take the Academic Mall route
cards.subtitle: Campus walking-tour landmark
cards.notes: Use the mall as the connective walk between stops; it is a practical place to slow down, regroup, and identify nearby buildings.
cards.short_summary: Make the campus mall the walking spine of the afternoon.
cards.evidence_claim: The Roy H. Cullen Academic Mall is a named stop on Southwestern’s self-guided walking tour.
cards.access_notes: Stay on established walkways and observe campus notices.

cards.title: Locate the McCombs Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Student-life stop on the official walking tour
cards.notes: Find the Campus Center during daylight, note its location for later campus services, and check university channels for current programming.
cards.short_summary: Identify a central student-life building before the week begins.
cards.evidence_claim: The Red & Charline McCombs Campus Center is a named stop on Southwestern’s self-guided walking tour.
cards.access_notes: Programs and indoor access vary; verify current details with Southwestern before relying on them.

cards.title: Visit the chapel grounds respectfully
cards.subtitle: Named campus-tour stop
cards.notes: Add the chapel to your daylight walk, take in the exterior and grounds, and keep the visit quiet if a service or program is underway.
cards.short_summary: A reflective pause within the official campus route.
cards.evidence_claim: Lois Perkins Chapel is a named stop on Southwestern’s self-guided walking tour.
cards.access_notes: Respect any service, event, or access restrictions in effect when you arrive.

cards.title: Spot the Olin Building
cards.subtitle: Academic stop on the university’s tour route
cards.notes: Use this stop to keep learning the academic side of campus; pair it with the next tour segment before moving toward recreation.
cards.short_summary: Continue the orientation walk through a named academic building.
cards.evidence_claim: The F. W. Olin Building is included on Southwestern’s self-guided walking tour.
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing is appropriate at any time; verify interior access locally.

cards.title: Find the Robertson Center
cards.subtitle: Campus recreation landmark on the official tour
cards.notes: Locate the Robertson Center, then review Campus Recreation’s current intramural, club, fitness, and outdoor-recreation options before joining anything.
cards.short_summary: Turn the walk into a practical recreation-resource check-in.
cards.evidence_claim: The Corbin J. Robertson Center is a self-guided tour stop, and Campus Recreation offers intramural sports, sport clubs, fitness, and outdoor recreation.
cards.access_notes: Participation, schedules, and facility access are set by Campus Recreation; check current details before going.

cards.title: Make a fine-arts stop
cards.subtitle: Home of the Sarofim School of Fine Arts
cards.notes: Walk by the Fine Arts Center and check the university calendar for a suitable public performance or gallery opportunity during the term.
cards.short_summary: Use the arts center to identify future cultural plans.
cards.evidence_claim: The Alma Thomas Fine Arts Center houses theaters, a recital hall, art gallery, studios, and practice rooms for Southwestern’s fine-arts programs.
cards.access_notes: Performance, gallery, and building access depend on the current event schedule and venue policies.

cards.entity_name: A. Frank Smith, Jr. Library Center
cards.title: End with the Smith Library Center
cards.subtitle: Library stop on the south side of campus
cards.notes: Finish your first campus loop by locating the library, then save its directions and services for your first study or research session.
cards.short_summary: Close the weekend route by finding a key academic resource.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith Library Center is on the south side of Southwestern’s campus and offers study rooms, reference, circulation, and other library services.
cards.source_title: Library location, directions to library, campus parking options
cards.access_notes: Confirm current library hours and any visitor or building-access requirements before entering.
